Six Flags and Cedar Fair park trip planning tools, now with expanded documentation.

- Provides live ride wait times, park hours, show schedules, and next-ride suggestions for all Six Flags and Cedar Fair parks.
- Supports every park in the merged chain, including Carowinds (default "home park"), Cedar Point, Magic Mountain, Hurricane Harbor, and more.
- Introduces a set of tools for ride status, showtimes, attraction directories, and planning efficient days.
- All queries can default to the user's home park or take any park input by name, id, or slug.
- Data sourced from themeparks.wiki; no login or key required.
